definitions.explanation: A false statement made with intent to deceive.

⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{嘘|うそ}⟦でしょう→でしょう：09887_deshou⟧！
examples.english: That must be a lie! / No way!

examples.english: I don't know if it's a lie or the truth.

examples.english: Lies are always found out eventually.

notes:
{嘘|うそ} means a lie or falsehood. Also commonly used as an exclamation expressing disbelief.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {嘘|うそ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to tell a lie
- {嘘|うそ}！: No way! / You're kidding! (exclamation of surprise)
- {嘘|うそ}⟦つき→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: liar
- {嘘|うそ}⟦みたい→みたい：10755_mitai⟧: unbelievable, seems too good to be true
- {嘘|うそ}⟦くさい→臭い：01133_kusai⟧: fishy, seems like a lie
- {嘘|うそ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{方便|ほうべん}→方便：noentry⟧: a white lie can be justified (lit. even lies can be expedient)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧: truth (everyday)
- ⟦{真実|しんじつ}→真実：05316_shinjitsu⟧: truth (formal/literary)

USAGE:
As an exclamation, {嘘|うそ}！ or うそ！ is very common in casual speech. It does not accuse someone of lying — it expresses surprise or disbelief, similar to English 'No way!' or 'Really?!'
